newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish taxi drivers go bald - for charity.
newsitem.headline: Irish taxi drivers go bald - for charity.

text.p: More than 350 Dublin taxi drivers or a third of all taximen in the city have gone bald but not because of an unknown occupational hazard.
The drivers took part on Monday in the biggest "shave-in" ever organised in Ireland, losing their locks in a bid to raise 75,000 punts ($120,000) for three Irish children's charities.
"Other charity events are over in a night but we will wear our baldness with pride over the next couple of months," said taxidriver Dermot Buckley, one of the organisers of the event.
The charities benefiting from the fund-raising include the Temple Street Children's Hospital, the Children's Leukaemia Research Project and the Irish cot death association.
